items.title: James Moody interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: Galileo and Leonardo DaVinci, they didn’t know anything about Pluto, Neptune, Uranus, they didn’t know.

ctx.x: There was a “Twilight Zone” episode about that.

Yeah. But I didn’t see that. I didn’t know. Yeah. I didn’t see that. But you know when you think about things, and then, check this out. In the configuration of where all the planets are, around the sun okay, all the planets are there in the world, NASA is there. Now, six thousand years ago, Galileo and Leonardo DaVinci, they didn’t know anything about Pluto, Neptune, Uranus, they didn’t know. But the Sumerian did six thousand years ago. And in their thing, the little stone figure carvings, you see the same…

comes every 3,600 years, and when it comes, what happens? And so they’re waiting to see what’s going to happen the next time. Now the flood, when it happened, like it wasn’t something that happened because the gods were angry. I mean man was destroyed because the gods were angry at man because man was a drag, but they knew that the flood was coming because of the configuration of certain planets, certain things happened, the ice melts, and all that. But I’m telling you, this book — he wrote, it’s called The Earth…
